title: data/glossary.json
description: Term to explanation. Every entry answers both halves of the question a newcomer actually has: what is this, and why is it in the picture. Terms are matched against flow node labels and project tags, and surface as hover explanations.

what.description: One sentence. What the thing is.

why.description: Why it is in this estate, and what breaks or costs money if it is misunderstood.
